remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before installing @runcomfy/cli, running npx, logging in, or launching a RunComfy job.
Disclose that video URLs and prompts are sent to RunComfy, and process only URLs that the user explicitly provided for this task.
Document token revocation and prefer scoped or temporary RUNCOMFY_TOKEN values in CI and shared environments.

content.value_statement: Changing a video aspect ratio can crop action or leave empty space. This skill guides RunComfy outpainting so the canvas expands while the subject stays centered.
actual_capabilities: Guides RunComfy CLI use for Wan 2-7 edit-video canvas expansion.
Helps convert vertical, square, or 4:3 clips into wider or taller formats.
Provides prompt patterns for matching background, lighting, and camera distance.
Recommends ComfyUI outpainting workflows when seam quality must be higher.
Explains common exit codes and RunComfy troubleshooting references.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a RunComfy account or token.
Wan 2-7 is prompt-driven and may show seam or temporal artifacts.
Dedicated ComfyUI outpainting workflows are GUI workflows, not CLI endpoints.
Repeated outpainting passes can reduce quality after about two passes.

use_cases.title: Repurpose Social Clips
use_cases.description: Convert vertical Reels or TikTok footage into horizontal video while keeping the action centered.

use_cases.title: Expand Brand Assets
use_cases.description: Turn square or narrow clips into wide banners with matching surrounding environment.

use_cases.title: Plan Restoration Formats
use_cases.description: Assess old 4:3 footage and choose a safer route for modern 16:9 delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Aspect Ratio Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one source video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use video-outpainting to convert my vertical clip to 16:9. Keep the subject centered and extend matching background on both sides. My video URL is [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Social Cut Repurpose
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert a short social clip for a different platform.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare this 9:16 social clip for YouTube. Recommend the RunComfy route, write the outpainting prompt, and note what I should inspect in the result.

prompt_templates.title: Hero Quality Route
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose between fast CLI output and higher seam quality.
prompt_templates.prompt: I need a polished brand video from this source clip. Decide whether Wan 2-7 is enough or whether I should use a ComfyUI outpainting workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Pass Expansion Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a two-pass outpainting plan for a 4:3 clip going to 16:9. Include prompt focus, quality checks, and when to stop.

output_examples.input: Convert a vertical product demo into a horizontal YouTube clip.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: Wan 2-7 Edit-Video. Extend left and right background, preserve central action, and review side seams before publishing.

output_examples.input: Expand a square campaign clip into a wide website banner.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: start with Wan 2-7 for a draft. Use a ComfyUI outpainting workflow if the banner needs hero-grade seam quality.
Recommended route: use a dedicated ComfyUI workflow. Old footage usually needs stronger temporal consistency and careful seam handling.

best_practices: Use only video URLs that the user explicitly provided for this outpainting task.
State the target aspect ratio first, then describe matching background details.
Choose ComfyUI workflows for strict seam quality, brand campaigns, or archival footage.
anti_patterns: Do not upload private or third-party media unless the user has permission.
Do not expect prompt-driven Wan 2-7 output to be flawless for hero delivery.
Do not chain many outpainting passes without checking artifacts after each pass.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps extend a video canvas with RunComfy so the output can fit a new aspect ratio.

faq.question: Does it add more time to the video?
faq.answer: No. It expands the spatial frame. It does not create additional frames before or after the clip.

faq.question: Which RunComfy model does it prefer?
faq.answer: It uses Wan 2-7 Edit-Video as the closest CLI route for prompt-shaped canvas expansion.

faq.question: When should I use a ComfyUI workflow instead?
faq.answer: Use ComfyUI workflows when seam quality, temporal consistency, or brand delivery standards are strict.

faq.question: Can it process private videos safely?
faq.answer: Treat source videos as sensitive. Only process media the user approved for RunComfy remote processing.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
